‘WELGA KAMI’

Members of transport group MANIBELA hold placards and chant slogans on the first day of a nationwide jeepney strike at their headquarters in Manila on Thursday.

The group urged the national government to prioritize the removal of excise tax and value-added tax (VAT) on fuel, and to consider repealing the Oil Deregulation Law. It added that around 100,000 transport workers nationwide have joined the ongoing protest.

📸 The STAR/Edd Gumban

data.raw_text: #WATCH | Chandigarh | On preparations for the IAF's Surya Kiran show, Deputy Commissioner (DC) of Chandigarh, Nishant Kumar Yadav says, "Our preparations are good. This air show is for two days, 27th and 28th March. Ten thousand people will be attending each day...We have set up seven pickup points throughout the city, from where people will arrive by bus. We have made arrangements for drinking water, toilets, cleanliness, and medical facilities, and we hope, I believe, that it will be a good experience for people...Approximately 1300 police personnel will be on duty, and for this, we have declared several areas around the lake as no-traffic zones. We also issued a traffic advisory yesterday, and anyone coming to the lake will be brought in by buses only. Private vehicles, such as Ola and Uber cabs, will not be allowed..."

TRAFFIC ADVISORY

Special traffic arrangements will be in place on the occasion of *Ram Navami on 26.03.2026 in view of a Shobha Yatra in Paharganj area.

A gathering of around 300 devotees is expected and traffic movement in surrounding areas may be affected.

Time: From 05 PM to 11 PM

📍 TRAFFIC ADVISORY
-Avoid Chemsford Road & Paharganj Market during the evening hours
-Expect congestion and slow vehicular movement in nearby areas
-Plan your journey in advance

📍Stay updated through Delhi Police Traffic channels.

#DPTrafficAdvisory
